newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian feedmills buy 30,000 tonnes soymeal.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian feedmills buy 30,000 tonnes soymeal.

text.p: A consortium of four Malaysian feedmillers has bought 30,000 tonnes of South American soymeal at $240 a tonne C&F for May 1997 shipment, traders based in Singapore said on Monday.
See Hoy Chan, Ho Seng Chan, QL Feedstuff and Gold Coin Bhd committed to the purchase of the low-protein soymeal last week, the traders said, adding that arrival would be in June.
"Based on today's prices, it seems like they've got a big discount, though we can never tell six months down the line," said a trader, referring to falling Chicago futures.
Prompt shipment Indian soymeal was quoted at $302-$303 a tonne C&F Malaysia on Monday while South American soymeal was indicated at between $280 and $290 a tonne C&F.
